title: Ammunition
wikitext:
'''Ammunition''' refers to all projectile types used by weapons in ''[[Escape From Duckov Wiki|Escape From Duckov]]''.

== Overview ==
Ammunition can be looted, crafted, or purchased from vendors.
Each ammo type is compatible with a specific weapon caliber.

== Calibers ==

=== AR (Rifle) ===
Standard rifle rounds for assault rifles and select carbines.

* [[Rusty Bullet (AR)]]
* [[Standard Bullet (AR)]]
* [[AP Bullet (AR)]]
* [[Advanced AP Bullet (AR)]]
* [[Special AP Bullet (AR)]]

=== L (Heavy) ===
Heavy, long-range rifle rounds designed for designated marksman rifles and support weapons.  
They provide superior penetration and damage at the cost of weight and recoil.

* [[Rusty Bullet (L)]]
* [[Standard Bullet (L)]]
* [[AP Bullet (L)]]
* [[Advanced AP Bullet (L)]]
* [[Special AP Bullet (L)]]

=== MAG (Magnum) ===
High-power “magnum” handgun rounds.  
Deliver massive impact and armor penetration but generate heavy recoil.

* [[Standard Bullet (MAG)]]
* [[AP Bullet (MAG)]]
* [[Advanced AP Bullet (MAG)]]
* [[Special AP Bullet (MAG)]]

=== Shotgun ===
Standard shells used by pump-action and semi-automatic shotguns.  
Effective at close range with wide spread; poor range and accuracy.

* [[Rusty Shotgun Shell]]
* [[Standard Shotgun Shell]]
* [[AP Shotgun Shell]]
* [[Advanced AP Shotgun Shell]]
* [[Special Shotgun Shell]]

=== S (Light) ===
Compact rounds used in SMGs and light sidearms.  
They offer high fire rate, low recoil, and moderate stopping power.

* [[Rusty Bullet (S)]]
* [[Standard Bullet (S)]]
* [[AP Bullet (S)]]
* [[Advanced AP Bullet (S)]]
* [[Special Bullet (S)]]

=== Sniper ===
Precision high-velocity rounds for sniper rifles.  
Exceptional penetration and damage, ideal for long-range combat.

* [[Rusty Sniper Bullet]]
* [[Standard Sniper Bullet]]
* [[AP Sniper Bullet]]
* [[Advanced AP Sniper Bullet]]
* [[Special AP Sniper Bullet]]

=== Arrow ===
Ammunition used by bows and similar projectile launchers.  
Low firing noise and moderate speed.

* [[Wooden Arrow]]
* [[Explosive Arrow]]
* [[Basic AP Arrow]]
* [[Intermediate AP Arrow]]

=== Energy ===
Cells or energy packs consumed by advanced energy-based weapons.  
Damage type and effects vary by weapon technology.

* [[Small Energy Bullet]]
* [[Enhanced Small Energy Bullet]]

=== Energy (Large) ===
High-capacity energy cells used by heavy or specialized energy weapons.  
Provide increased damage output, but are rare and expensive.

* [[Large Energy Bullet]]

=== Poop Bullet ===
Novelty ammunition type used by comedic or experimental weapons.  
Low damage but often features unique effects or humor-based design.

* [[Poop Bullet]]

=== Rocket ===
Ammunition for dedicated rocket launchers.  
Explosive payloads with large area damage but limited ammo capacity.

* [[Rocket Lv.1]]

title: Attachments
wikitext:
'''Attachments''' are weapon modifications that improve or alter a firearm’s performance. They can change characteristics such as accuracy, recoil, aiming speed, or magazine capacity. Attachments can be installed on most [[Weapons#Ranged_Weapons|ranged weapons]] depending on their compatibility.

==Attachment Types==

===Scope===
Scopes provide aiming assistance and zoom capabilities. They range from compact holographic and red dot sights for close combat to optical rifle scopes designed for long-distance engagements.

* [[Digital Sight]]
* [[Holographic Sight]]
* [[Quick Sight]]
* [[Red Dot Sight]]
* [[2x Scope]]
* [[Rifle 4x Scope]]
* [[Rifle 8x Scope]]

===Muzzle===
Muzzle attachments modify weapon sound, recoil pattern, and sometimes damage output. Each weapon class supports its own set of muzzle devices, from suppressors to damage-boosting compensators.

====Rifle====
* [[Rifle Muzzle Brake (Spread)]]
* [[Rifle Suppressor]]
* [[Rifle Extended Muzzle]]
* [[Rifle Muzzle Brake (Balanced A)]]
* [[Rifle Muzzle Brake (Balanced B)]]
* [[Rifle Spiral Muzzle Brake]]
* [[Rifle DMG-Boosting Muzzle]]
* [[Rifle Vertical Muzzle Brake]]
* [[Rifle Horizontal Muzzle Brake]]

====Pistol====
* [[Pistol Suppressor]]
* [[Pistol Muzzle Brake (Balanced A)]]
* [[Pistol Muzzle Brake (Balanced B)]]
* [[Pistol Extended Muzzle]]
* [[Pistol DMG-Boosting Muzzle]]

====Shotgun====
* [[Shotgun Muzzle Brake (Balanced A)]]
* [[Shotgun Muzzle Brake (Mobility)]]
* [[Shotgun DMG-Boosting Muzzle]]
* [[Shotgun Heavy Suppressor]]

====SMG====
* [[SMG Suppressor]]
* [[SMG Muzzle Brake (Balanced B)]]
* [[SMG Spiral Muzzle Brake]]
* [[SMG Vertical Muzzle Brake]]
* [[SMG Horizontal Muzzle Brake]]

====Sniper Rifle====
* [[Sniper Rifle Muzzle Brake (Spread)]]
* [[Sniper Rifle Suppressor]]
* [[Sniper Rifle Extended Muzzle]]
* [[Sniper Rifle Muzzle Brake (Balanced A)]]
* [[Sniper Rifle Muzzle Brake (Mobility)]]
* [[Sniper Rifle DMG-Boosting Muzzle]]
* [[Sniper Rifle Horizontal Muzzle Brake]]

===Grip===
Grips enhance weapon control during sustained fire. They improve accuracy, reduce spread, and make recoil recovery faster.

* [[Quick Grip A]]
* [[Quick Grip B]]
* [[Balanced Grip]]
* [[Vertical Grip I]]
* [[Vertical Grip II]]
* [[Horizontal Grip I]]
* [[Horizontal Grip II]]
* [[Hip-Fire Grip I]]
* [[Hip-Fire Grip II]]

===Stock===
Stocks stabilize the weapon and reduce recoil impact. Some variants also affect aiming speed or hip-fire accuracy depending on their design.

* [[Balanced Stock I]]
* [[Balanced Stock II]]
* [[Control Stock]]
* [[Quick Stock]]
* [[Light Stock]]
* [[Hip-Fire Stock]]

===Tactic===
Tactical attachments primarily enhance handling characteristics rather than adding new functionality. Laser sights improve factors such as weapon spread or aiming speed, while the flashlight increases visibility in dark environments.

* [[Tactical Flashlight]]
* [[Laser (Mobility)]]
* [[Laser (Rapid Response)]]
* [[Laser (Calibration)]]
* [[Laser (CRIT)]]

===Magazine===
Magazines define ammunition capacity and reloading efficiency. Higher-tier magazines may offer increased capacity or faster reloads depending on the weapon class.

====Rifle====

* [[Rifle Quick Magazine II]]
* [[Rifle Extended Magazine I]]

title: Bitcoin Miner
wikitext:
{{Item|title=Bitcoin Miner|image=bitcoinminer.png}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a building in [[Escape From Duckov Wiki|Escape From Duckov]].
== Description ==
''Mining stuff, you know.''

== ''Necessary'' ==

* 28,000 [[money]]
* 3x [[Cables]]
* 2x [[Power Cord]]
* 3x [[R6 Battery]]
* 3x [[Computing Core]]
* 3x [[Portable Hard Drive]]

== Function ==
Bitcoin Miner automatically produces [[0.2 BTC]] through time when at least one Graphics Card is installed.

Bitcoin Miner has 12 Graphics Card slots. Each Graphics Card slot can hold any Graphics Card. Each installed Graphic Card provides Hashrate. The speed at which Bitcoins are produced depends on the total Hashrate of all installed Graphic Cards. Higher Hashrate yields shorter production time.

Supported Graphics Cards and Hashrate per card are as follows:
* [[Potato Graphics Card]]: 0.1
* [[Graphics Card]]: 1
* [[Graphics Card SLI]]: 1.5

Production is driven by a hidden progress bar. The bar has a length of 4,572,000. 
* If Hashrate is below 1, the bar advances by (55 ∗ Hashrate) per second.
* If Hashrate is no less than 1, the bar advances by (7 ∗ Hashrate + 48) per second.
When it reaches the full length, one [[0.2 BTC]] is produced and the bar resets to 0. The Estimated Time per Coin and the remaining production time of the next Coin are shown. ''(There is a bug that the Estimated Time per Coin is incorrect when Hashrate is below 1, though the actual time is not affected.)''

Example Estimated Time per Coin, with the following Graphics Cards installed:
* 1x [[Potato Graphics Card]]: 240:00:00 ''(Though shown as 240:59:59)''
* 12x [[Potato Graphics Card]]: 23:24:15 
* 1x [[Graphics Card]]: 24:00:00
* 12x [[Graphics Card]]: 10:00:00
* 12x [[Graphics Card SLI]]: 7:35:10

Bitcoin Miner has 4 Output slots. Produced [[0.2 BTC]] items appear in the Output slots. If all Output slots are full, production pauses immediately. When space becomes available, production resumes without resetting the progress bar. Any [[Items|Item]] can be placed in and occupies Output slots, which may stop Bitcoin production.

title: Black Market Contact
wikitext:
The Black Market Contact is a building in Escape from Duckov. It is both a place where you can sell and buy items.

There are three tabs that you can access when you go up to it. The Upgrade tab, which allows you to upgrade the Black Market's refresh button, the Supply tab, which allows you to buy items for the price listed. This will list 8 random items, which are displayed with a low price, the normal price or a high price. The items you buy from the Supply tab are sent to your locker. And then there is the Demand tab, which has another 8 boxes with random items, and these boxes can say, e.g., 5 Cardboard Boxes for x amount of money. It will sell items from your stash and inventory, but if it sells a gun perhaps, with attachments on it, the attachments should automatically get detached before the weapon gets sold.

title: Bunker
wikitext:
{{Location
|image=MiniMap_Base_SceneV2.png
|map=Bunker
|title=Bunker}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[map]] in ''Escape from Duckov''.
== Description ==
The staging base for everyone's duckling. Health, hunger, and thirst will automatically regenerate while in the bunker and time will pass as normal - useful for riding out the storms. Ammo is not consumed while in base. The ladder located on the north side takes the player into the southern edge of [[Ground Zero]].    

This area includes the lower river area, accessible from a ladder to the northeast. The sewer gives the player an alternate access route into Ground Zero. This sewer area contains a shrine where [[Fading Feather|Fading Feathers]] can be exchanged for random [[Totems]]. The ferryman can also take the player to [[Farm Town]] or the Demo Challenge. Lastly, the player can fish from the dock, though they'll only obtain minor fish.    

== NPCs ==
The following NPCs appear in the bunker to offer Missions:

* '''Jeff''' - unlocked by default
* '''Mud''' - unlocked with the [[Gym]]
* '''Orange''' - unlocked with the [[Armor Shop]]
* '''Xavier''' - unlocked with the [[Weapon Shop]]
* '''Xiaoming''' - unlocked with the [[Tech Center]]
* '''Vogo''' - unlocked with the [[Kitchen]]

== Facilities ==
The following facilities are unlocked by default:

* '''Warehouse''': Store all your items. The warehouse can be accessed from anywhere in the bunker. Expanding the warehouse increases its capacity.
* '''Vending Machine''': Purchase some basic supplies here.
* '''Enhancement Station''': Purchase upgrades for your character.
* '''Bedroom''': You will appear here after extracting or respawning. The bedroom lets you skip time, change your character's appearance, etc.
* '''Target Range:''' Practice with your weapons against varying levels of armored dummies.
* '''Offering Circle''': Exchange [[Fading Feather|Fading Feathers]] for [[Totems]]

The following [[buildings]] are added by unlocking and then constructing them:

* '''[[Workbench]]''': Craft, repair, and dismantle items, and research blueprints.
* '''[[Gym]]''': Physical training with Mud to improve stats like stamina, carry weight, hunger drain, etc. Also purchase injectors.
* '''[[Armor Shop]]''': Purchase armor and some equipment from Orange.
* '''[[Weapon Shop]]''': Purchase firearms and ammunition from Xavier.
* '''[[Key Registration Device]]''': Save keys so that you can permanently unlock their associated doors.
* '''[[Kitchen]]''': Have a steady supply of food to replenish you. Also, learn survival skills from Vogo to improve your hunger and thirst stats, and fishing abilities.
* '''[[Recipe: Black Potion|Medic Station]]''': Craft medical supplies and research medical blueprints
* [[Tech Center|'''Tech Center''']]: Purchase some mission-specific items and blueprints from Xiaoming
* '''[[ATM]]''': convert [[Cash]] to [[Currency]] and vice versa.
* [[Bitcoin Miner|'''Bitcoin Miner''']]: mine for [[0.2 BTC]] passively; the mining speed increases when you find and install more graphics cards.
* [[Black Market Contact Point|'''Black Market Contact Point''']]: Purchase or sell randomly selected items, including those not normally available at vendors.
* '''[[Demo Trophy]]''' ; Access unique challenge.
* '''[[Teleporter]]''': Teleport to locations where you've activated a beacon

title: Fly Captain
wikitext:
{{Character|name={{PAGENAME}}|image=Fly Captain.png}}

'''Fly Captain''' is a [[Boss]] in [[Escape From Duckov Wiki|Escape From Duckov]].

== Description ==

== Location ==
Fly Captain can be found either at the Construction Site Dormitory or the Office Building Apartment in [[Farm Town]], escorted by x2 [[Fly Member|Fly Members]].
[[File:Farm Town - Fly Captain Location.png|none|thumb|437x437px]]He and his minions can also be found in the [[J-Lab Research Facility]], specifically in the bathrooms at the northwest side of Level 2.

== Strategy ==
Having a Poison RES Injector would be ideal but in the case where it's not available, avoid fighting the Fly Captain and his minions indoors as the limited space makes it very difficult to dodge their attacks.

The Fly Captain also throws poop bombs which deals illness via poison, and all of them shoot poop bullets which can also cause illness. Keeping several stacks of Bandages, or even a Recovery Injector, is vital as the poison can easily kill players even when retreating. Bandages can be used very quickly in comparison to First Aids, and the healing rate of Recovery Injectors can counteract the damage caused by poison.

== Equipment ==

* [[Armor Lv3|Lv.3 Body Armor]]
* [[Steel Helmet]]
* [[Poop Shitgun]]
* [[Fly Goggles]]
* [[Fly Wings]]

== Possible Loot ==

* [[Crimson Core Fragment]]
* [[Poop Bullet|Poop Bullets]]

* This boss is NOT guaranteed to spawn when you load into Farm Town.

title: Lordon
wikitext:
{{Character|name={{PAGENAME}}|image=lordon.png}}'''Lordon''' is a [[Boss]] in [[Escape From Duckov Wiki|Escape From Duckov]].

== Description ==
''"There's a freak in the Warehouse Area - comes and goes like a ghost, aways with a dog by his side. And he usually snipes from miles away. Teach him a lesson."'' - [[Jeff]].

== Location ==

Lordon can be found roaming the [[Warehouse Area]], escorted by x1 [[Lordon's Dog]].

== Strategy ==
Lordon are very dangerous when confronted in open field. His high damage and precise shooting can deal with player in 2-3 shots (Depending on armor and talent chosen). His dog usually show up first, so if you being chased by one - direction where dog came from should be approached with caution. As soon as you see his tactical laser pointed at you - look for any kind of cover ASAP, sprinting and dodging. 

Hug structure corners to make him shot and then peek to deal damage, then retreat around structure to keep Lorden around corner constantly breaking line of sight when he tries to shoot.

Sandbags can be used as nice cover to shot from if he is already in your gun reach. South Green House or Lumberyard fallen logs can be used as great indestructible sandbags alternative to shoot safely.

Tactical Headsets are nice item to have to keep track of boss movement while behind cover.

== Equipment ==

* [[VPO (Lordon Mod)]]
* [[Lv.3 Body Armor]]

== Possible Loot ==

* [[Recipe: Expansion Crate (L)]]
* [[Crimson Core Fragment]]
* [[School Bag]]
* [[Aspirin]]
* [[Bandage]]
* [[Standard Sniper Bullet]]

== Notes ==

* Killing this boss for the 1st time awards the "Judgment on Lordon" [[Achievements|achievement]].

title: Man of Light
wikitext:
{{Character|name={{PAGENAME}}|image=1.png}}
'''Man of Light''', known as Big Chicken, is a [[Boss]] in [[Escape From Duckov Wiki|Escape From Duckov]].

== Description ==
''"If you see a white guy out here, don't mess with him. Don't ask me how I know that."'' - [[Notes]], Roadside Friendly Reminder.

== Location ==
Man of Light can be found either at a camp northwest of Forest Path or in an area south of Road Camp in [[Ground Zero]].
[[File:Ground Zero - Man of Light Location.png|none|thumb|437x437px]]

== Strategy ==
Man of Light's melee attack is one of the highest in-game, but his attack pattern is very simple. The best strategy is simply to shoot at him while retreating backwards, and dodging his axe once he gets close. For early-game players, his axe can easily kill in one or two hits, and he can be found routinely fighting other enemies nearby such as Scavengers and Spider-Bots. If found in that scenario, let them weaken the Man of Light, as he's surely to beat them.

== Equipment ==

* [[Battle Axe]]

== Possible Loot ==

== Notes ==

* Killing this boss for the 1st time awards the "Do You Believe in Light" [[Achievements|achievement]].
* This boss is guaranteed to spawn when you load into Ground Zero, at either one of the two locations.

{{Character|name={{PAGENAME}}|image=Pato Chapo.png}}'''Pato Chapo''' is a [[Boss]] in [[Escape From Duckov Wiki|Escape From Duckov]].
== Description ==
''"Here in Ground Zero, I, Pato Chapo, call the shots."'' - [[Notes]], Road Camp Notes.

== Location ==
Pato Chapo is located at Road Camp in Northeast [[Ground Zero]], escorted by x3-4 [[Mercenary|Mercenaries]].
[[File:Ground Zero - Pato Chapo Location.png|none|thumb|437x437px]]

== Strategy ==
Early game, Pato Chapo can be proven to be a challenge due to his higher damage (relative to other enemies at Ground Zero) and his escort of Mercenaries. The use of the surrounding sandbags is advised, but be careful as Pato Chapo's attacks can destroy them quickly, and he has a tendency of dodging once shot at. If the sandbags were destroyed, retreat and take cover behind obstacles or other sandbags, and heal as necessary. Avoid getting close as for starting player, his AK-47 can rapidly shred one's health.

== Equipment ==

* [[Armor Lv3|Lv.3 Body Armor]]
* [[AK-47]]

== Possible Loot ==

* [[Crimson Core Fragment]]
* [[Hot-Blood Injector]]
* [[First Aid Kit (S)]]
* [[First Aid Kit]]
* [[Bandage]]
* [[Portable Hard Drive]]
* [[TOMSUNG Phone]]
* [[Factory Access Card]]
* [[Standard Bullet (AR)]]
* [[Cash]]

== Notes ==

* Killing this boss for the 1st time awards the "Overlord of Ground Zero" [[Achievements|achievement]].
* Killing this boss for the 10th time awards the "Grinder Sharpshooter" [[Achievements|achievement]].
* This boss is guaranteed to spawn when you load into Ground Zero.

title: Roadblock
wikitext:
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Boss]] in [[Escape From Duckov Wiki|Escape From Duckov]].

== Description ==
'''Roadblock''' is the last boss of [[J-Lab Research Facility]] and there is always an extraction point near him.

== Location ==
'''Roadblock''' is a found in the North-West corner of the Level 1 of [[J-Lab Research Facility]].
You need to activate a switch on the Level 2 to open access to this area (1 time access).
This, in turn, requires to activate a switch on Level 1 and a [[Lv.2 J-Lab Certificate]].

== Strategy ==
'''Roadblock''' functions very similarly to a Spider Bot in his attack patterns, yet with very high health and a different projectile pattern.
He shoots streams of Fire-elemental projectiles in a triple-shot pattern which punishes rolling to either side, as well as having a very high chance to Ignite the player. These shots can easily be avoided at long range with slight movement, but '''Roadblock''' has both a very long aggro range and the shots travel a very long distance while maintaining high damage. Effective early game strategies involve either using range and cover to chip away at his high health or using close distances and the cover provided by his arena to avoid his barrages while getting damage in. It is important to note that '''Roadblock''' can easily detect the player in the long hallway past the Offices area and will keep moving forward towards the player within the arena.

== Equipment ==

* [[Roadblock Helmet]]
* [[Lv.4 Body Armor]]

== Possible Loot ==

* Its Equipment
* [[Lv.3 J-Lab Certificate]]

== Notes ==
Looting '''Roadblock''' and returning to [[Ground Zero]] is one of the only two ways to enter [[Storm Area]] as Update 1.3.12 has "added a new path from J-Lab to Storm Area". If this new path requires the Lv.3 Certificate, then '''Roadblock''' is still a necessary boss to defeat in order to unlock the Storm Area.

title: Speedy Group Commander
wikitext:
{{Character|name={{PAGENAME}}|image=Speedy Group Commander.png}}

'''Speedy Group Commander''' is a [[Boss]] in [[Escape From Duckov Wiki|Escape From Duckov]].

== Description ==
''"They say there's an insanely fast yellow duck in the Warehouse Area. I'm not convinced - hit yourself with a Yellow Injector and race him."'' - [[Mud]].

== Location ==
Speedy Group Commander can be found either at the Wester Factory or at Farmhouse in the [[Warehouse Area]], escorted by x3-4 [[Speedy Group Member|Speedy Group Members]].

== Strategy ==
Using sniper rifles and retreating between shots to keep distance could be a nice strategy to deal with entire speedy group. Do keep in mind that as the name implies, the whole group are very fast and shoot rapidly and frequently. If spawned at the Farmhouse, one strategy is to lure them to the southeast bridge (if fixed), in order to corner them and make it easier to aim at.

== Equipment ==

* [[Electrified MP7]]
* [[Lv.3 Body Armor]]

== Possible Loot ==

* [[Blueprint: Electrified MP7]]
* [[Crimson Core Fragment]]
* [[Yellow Injector]]
* [[Standard Bullet (S)]]
* [[Cash]]

== Notes ==

* Killing this boss for the 1st time awards the "Speedy Group Commander" [[Achievements|achievement]].

title: Storm
wikitext:
{{Stub}}
The [[Storm]] is an environmental disturbance that deals damage to the player if they don't have proper [[:Category:Storm Protection|Storm Protection]]. The [[Storm Area]] has a permanent high damage storm.

== When ==

A storm occurs every 200hours and lasts for 24 hours. Each storm has two phases of 12 hours.

== Monsters ==

Similar to the night, there are monsters specific to the storm.
Unlike the Robot Spiders for the night, these monsters appear very quickly when the Storm starts and disappear when it stops.

Regular Mobs and [[Boss]]es are still present during the storm and do not take any damage from the storm.
It seems that regular Mobs are somewhat stronger during the storm (to be confirmed).

Some of the Storm monsters are quite nasty

== Drops ==


== Safe Zones ==
Buildings are not safe, even with doors closed.

* The cave in [[Ground Zero]] is safe from Storm damage (but there is typically a storm monster inside)
* [[J-Lab Research Facility]] is safe and has no Storm Monsters
* Bunkers in [[Storm Area]] are safe

== Storm Damage ==

The storm deals damage over time that is quite hard to compensate with healing.
So you typically wants total protection against it.

See [[:Category:Storm Protection]].

Storm Protection required:
* Phase I : 1
* Phase II : 2
* [[Storm Area]] : 2

== Description ==
''Embodies nearly all of J-Lab's strom research.''

== Location ==
[[File:Screenshot 2025-11-26 at 8.39.42 PM.png|thumb|265x265px]]
The '''Storm Gun Blueprint''' is found in the '''Storm Area''' on the top left where the circle of trees is located.  

In order for the data box (blueprint) to appear, you have to defeat Gulu Gulu, Billy Billy, Pala Pala, Pulu Pulu all located in the four bunkers in the Storm Area.  

They will all drop their according helmets: Gulu Gulu Helmet, Billy Billy Helmet, Pala Pala Helmet, and Pulu Pulu Helmet.  

You will need to submit these helmets beside the circle of trees based on its colour, located top left of the storm area. Once you have submitted each of the helmets in its own place, the blueprint for the storm gun will appear in the middle of the circle of trees.

title: Totems
wikitext:
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' are special equippable items that grant passive bonuses while worn. Totems are created '''randomly''' at the Summoning Circle located in the basement of the [[Bunker]].

To create a totem, the player can offer either:
* '''8''' [[Fading Feather|Fading Feathers]] — produces '''1 random totem''';
* '''80''' Fading Feathers — produces '''10 random totems at once'''.

Only one totem of the same level and type can be equipped at a time (e.g., two '''Ninja I''' totems cannot be used simultaneously), but totems of different levels of the same type can be equipped together (e.g., '''Ninja I''', '''Ninja II''', and '''Ninja III'''). There are no restrictions on combining different totem categories.

Totems provide a wide range of effects, including combat bonuses, resistances, mobility improvements, and resource efficiency. Most totem types feature three levels, with higher levels granting stronger or additional effects.

== Description ==
''A TOZ-66 loaded with Dragon's Breath rounds, firing burning bullets.''

== Usages ==

* Objective in [[Quests|Quest]]:
** [[Special Weapon]] (Submit: '''TOZ-66 Dragon's Breath''' x1)
** [[Experimental Materials]] (Kill Storm Creature x6 with '''TOZ-66 Dragon's Breath''')
* Used in [[Skills|Skill Enhancement]]: 
** Gun Mastery III (requires '''TOZ-66 Dragon's Breath''' x1)

* Crafted at the [[Workbench]], blueprint acquired after completing the "[[Special Weapon]]" quest.
* Dropped by [[Shotgunner]] in [[Farm Town]].

=== Recipe ===
Requires [[Blueprint: TOZ-66 Dragon's Breath]]
* [[TOZ-66]] x1
* [[Propane]] x1
* [[Intermediate Weapon Parts]] x2

=== Dismantling ===

* [[Weapon Parts]] x2
* [[Intermediate Weapon Parts]] x1

== Attachments ==
* Muzzle
* Grip
* Stock

== Notes ==
The Dragon's Breath is an improved version of the baseline [[TOZ-66]]:

* Dragon's Breath has 0.4 faster Fire Rate than the TOZ-66.
* Dragon's Breath has -1.5m Range less than the TOZ-66.
* Dragon's Breath has -1.9 Sound Range than the TOZ-66.
* Dragon's Breath has a 25% to cause a Debuff. TOZ-66 does not.

title: Update
wikitext:
This page contains information about updates to [[Escape From Duckov Wiki|Escape From Duckov]] Demo


== June 13, 2025 ==
Official version under continuous development! Stay tuned!
Small suggestion: Limit the game's frame rate in the settings, otherwise the game will fully utilize your GPU.

【Update Content】
Fixes
* Potentially fixed a crash-causing bug (took a long time to find!)
* Fixed a bug that caused blurry visuals. (Not only was it blurry, but characters also had jittery movement. Finally fixed!)

== June 11, 2025 ==
【Update Content】
Updates
* Reduced enemy turning speed when in non-combat states. Enemies no longer turn instantly.
* Added a new "fun item". Everyone is welcome to find it.
Fixes
* Changed the backend to Mono. This is expected to improve crash issues. It will also facilitate the collection of crash information.

== June 9, 2025 ==
【Update Content】
Updates
* Added a toggle option for UI shadows (If you experience crashes, turning this off may help).
Fixes:
* Added missing localization content.
* Auto backup and recovery for game settings data.
* Fixed several in-game errors.

== June 6, 2025 ==
【Update Content】
* Adjusted the model for the Storm Creature's loot box.
* Mouse side buttons can now be bound in key settings.
* Added scroll wheel behavior options in key settings (Switch Weapon / Switch Interaction).
* Added alternative keybinds for switching weapons and interactions.
* Walking Mushroom bullet speed increased by 50%, range increased by 20%, and slightly faster firing rate.
* Enemy AI improved: After being hit by the player, vision range increases for 1 second.
* During storms, a Storm Creature will appear in the cave.
* Increased range for SKS (26 → 30) and M1A (27.5 → 33), faster aim-down-sight speed (0.6 → 0.5 and 0.8 → 0.6), reduced aiming spread, and improved SKS reload speed (0.5 → 0.35).
* Reduced spread and recoil for Fire AK-47.
* Increased recoil for all shotguns.
* Recovery Injections can no longer stack.
* Storm Protection Injection now removes the “Disturbance” debuff (Weak Spatial Storm).
* Added “Other” tab in the Warehouse.
Fixes:
* Fixed the bug where enemies wouldn't detect players at close range (again).
* Fixed critical rate not showing on some melee weapons.
* Removed ununlockable blueprints from the Recipe Handbook.
* Fixed several sound bugs.


== June 5, 2025 ==
【Update Content】
* Added new weapon and blueprint: MP-155 ULTIMA.
* You can now change difficulty and talents at the Base.
* Muddy now sells Recovery Injections, which continuously restore HP for 30 seconds after use.
* Electric MP7 damage increased (7.5 → 8.5).
* Rapid Lordon damage reduced by 10%.
* Wrench and Car Wrench are now melee weapons.
* Sledgehammer damage increased (30 → 36).
* Aiming speed improved for VPO (1 → 0.8) and Mosin-Nagant (0.95 → 0.75).
* Added something fun during rainy weather (watch out).
* New food item: Mushroom.
* Added item lock feature in the backpack (hotkey: L) for easier sorting and quick deposit.
* Pet Backpack UI position adjusted.
* M1A can now equip magazines.
Fixed:
* Removed demo-only blueprints from the Recipe Handbook and added unlockable ones.
* Fixed a bug caused by splitting items while performing other actions.
* Fixed AI not detecting enemies in close range.
* Attachments: Laser - Basic and Laser - Calibrated now properly reflect their effects in the stats panel.
* Fixed display issues in non-Simplified Chinese for some new tasks and items.

== June 4, 2025 ==
【Update Content】
* Fixed an issue where interactions could not be recognized when items were placed in the melee weapon slot (e.g., digging with a shovel).

== June 4, 2025 ==
【Update Content】
Updates
* Implemented the [Unstuck] feature (can be used for cheating in some cases; abusing it may reduce the overall gameplay experience).
*  Shovel, hammer, sledgehammer, crowbar, and golf club are now classified as melee weapons.
* Melee weapons now feature headshot and bleeding attributes.
* Added an early backpack upgrade (+5 slots).
* Added a “Store All to Warehouse” button to the backpack.
* Removed the damage penalty for high-penetration rounds (damage coefficient unified to 1).
* Reduced damage taken in the lowest difficulty (from 60% to 50%).
* Kills from bleeding now count toward objectives.
* Fog of war removed in the lowest difficulty.
* Reduced Dwarf Duck’s vision range and attack range by 10%. Also reduced the movement penalty when it is outside vision range.
* Camera no longer zooms while looting.
* Improved the shooting sound effects of Storm Creatures.
* Added additional enemy spawn points near the bunker in the Zero Area.
* Added a disassemble shortcut key (F).
* Added sound effects when completing objectives.
* Gun-related missions now automatically remove attachments upon submission.
Fixes
* Fixed an issue where headshots on Da Xingxing might miss.
* Fixed abnormal spread reduction behavior when aiming with certain guns.
* Fixed an issue where progress was not saved when exiting during evacuation.
* Fixed inconsistent results when organizing the backpack.
* Fixed duplication issue with Tail No.1 and No.3.
* Fixed the icon for L-type bullets.
